notablePrerequisites: Kibo does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Kibo by tapping it, causing each player to create a Banana artifact token.
Grinding Station triggers, untapping itself.
Activate the Banana by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R/G} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping itself.
Activate Patriar's Seal's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Kibo.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Grinding Station and Summoning Station, untapping Patriar's Seal.
Repeat.
